body.x: Cellluon(www.celluon.com) has displayed varied & special laser projection series for several years, and the Magic Cube one of them has scored its big break by recording drastic growth rate over 30times when compared with last year.

In particular, 'Prodigy' unveiled at CES 2012 is an All-in-one iPhone case which minimizes the smart device's size and provides speed typing like notebook with projection laser type keyboard. Also, it has standing function.
In addition, 'Motion awareness technology' is attracting many attentions from overseas major companies.

"Now 'Produgy' offers only English service but we will add other foreign languages including French, Arabic, Spanish soon according to demand of overseas buyers" and "Also we will expand the line-up range from iPhone to other smartphone" said Rae-myeong Cha CEO of Celluon.
He said continually "Soft bank visited our booth and we made a meeting schedule with Japan major electronics company S at CES" and "We expect 4 or 5 times sales growth this year"
